description: This repository contains the code and data for the study Enhancing Uncertain Demand Prediction in Hospitals Using Simple and Advanced Machine Learning by Hu, Stockman, Zhi, Wood, Wu and Chén. It forecasts hourly patient arrivals at the Rambam Medical Center in Haifa, Israel, three and seven days ahead, comparing a time-varying linear model estimated with a Kalman filter and LSTM neural networks against seasonal naive, RVAR and TBATS benchmarks. The data are per-patient visit records for 2004 to 2007 from the Technion's Service Enterprise Engineering Lab (SEELab), plus temperature from the Haifa Port weather station; 2004 and 2005 are used for training, 2006 is held out because the Lebanon war disrupted it, and January to October 2007 is the test period. Python scripts rebuild the hourly series, train each model and reproduce the paper's tables with paired bootstrap comparisons. Everything is free to download from GitHub. Caveats: no licence file was found, the data are nearly twenty years old, and they cover one hospital. Coverage is one hospital in Israel. Simulation uses: arrival forecasts as demand inputs to emergency department and bed capacity models. Related records: the ED simulation model (model-comses-emergency-department-simulation-italy) shows how such arrivals move through an emergency department.
